families.name: Component definitions and instance identity
families.scope: Author versioned local component definitions and distinct instances in the canonical document while preserving explicit source ownership.
families.refusal: Refuse definition cycles, ambiguous source ownership, dangling instance references and structural writes that lack the required command capability.
families.recovery: Restore component definitions and instances together from a revision-bound local snapshot without regenerating unrelated source.
families.feedback: Show definition versus instance scope, affected instance counts and unsupported source mappings before applying a change.
families.evidence: Use two differently configured instances, nested definitions and an unsupported source-owned component to verify exact scoped effects.

capabilities.title: Create component definitions
capabilities.outcome: An author can name a reusable local definition from an eligible canonical subtree, with its root identity and ownership recorded independently from instances.

capabilities.title: Instantiate registered components
capabilities.outcome: An author can insert a selected definition into a page and receive a distinct instance identity that resolves to the chosen definition version.

capabilities.title: Inspect definition membership
capabilities.outcome: Selecting a nested node shows which definition owns it and whether the node belongs to shared structure or instance-specific content.

capabilities.title: Locate component instances
capabilities.outcome: A definition inspector lists every local instance with page and node identifiers, allowing navigation without aggregating private descendant text.

capabilities.title: Rename component definitions
capabilities.outcome: Renaming a definition updates library labels and references while preserving stable definition and instance identifiers across the local document.

capabilities.title: Duplicate component definitions
capabilities.outcome: Duplicating a definition creates independent identities for its owned nodes while retaining external asset and collection references explicitly.

capabilities.title: Detach component instances
capabilities.outcome: An explicit detach preview converts one instance into independent local nodes and reports which shared properties and future updates will stop applying.

capabilities.title: Preview shared definition edits
capabilities.outcome: Before a definition edit, the builder lists affected instances and shows representative before-and-after previews without modifying any page.

capabilities.title: Apply shared definition revisions
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed definition command advances its revision and updates only instances that follow that definition, preserving independent instance values.

capabilities.title: Inspect component dependency graphs
capabilities.outcome: The library shows direct and transitive component dependencies with cycle indicators and bounded navigation to the owning local definitions.

capabilities.title: Refuse recursive component insertion
capabilities.outcome: Inserting a component into its own dependency ancestry produces a specific cycle explanation and leaves both definitions and instances unchanged.

capabilities.title: Separate source-owned definitions
capabilities.outcome: Imported React components display their source ownership and supported edit operations, keeping unsupported structure changes unavailable in the visual editor.

capabilities.title: Define component root semantics
capabilities.outcome: An author chooses an allowed semantic root for a document-owned component and previews resulting landmarks and layout constraints before confirmation.

capabilities.title: Group component internal nodes
capabilities.outcome: An author can assign named internal groups that aid selection without introducing extra rendered elements or changing instance semantics.

capabilities.title: Track unused component definitions
capabilities.outcome: The library identifies definitions with no live instances, distinguishing truly unused definitions from dependencies of other reusable components.

capabilities.title: Archive unused definitions
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed archive command removes an unused definition from insertion choices while retaining its version history and recoverable metadata.

capabilities.title: Restore archived definitions
capabilities.outcome: An author can restore an archived definition under its original identity when no conflicting active definition exists in the local registry.

capabilities.title: Inspect definition source coverage
capabilities.outcome: The inspector reports which definition nodes have verified source mappings, generated ownership or unresolved mappings before any source-oriented operation.

capabilities.title: Preview component instance isolation
capabilities.outcome: A comparison view renders two instances with different local values and identifies shared structure without implying that instance content is globally synchronized.

capabilities.title: Export component identity manifests
capabilities.outcome: An author can export a local manifest of definition and instance identities, dependency versions and ownership without bundling credentials or runtime state.

families.name: Typed component properties
families.scope: Define typed component inputs, defaults and instance values with explicit serialization and editor control contracts.
families.refusal: Refuse incompatible values, missing required inputs, unsafe URL schemes and migrations that silently discard saved instance values.
families.recovery: Retain previous property schemas and instance values so a rejected or undone schema change restores the exact prior configuration.
families.feedback: Expose property type, inherited default, instance override and validation location using readable names rather than color alone.
families.evidence: Exercise text, numeric, boolean, URL, media and structured inputs across multiple instances and round-trip their serialized values.

capabilities.title: Declare text properties
capabilities.outcome: A component author can expose a named text input with a documented default and character constraints, editable independently on each instance.

capabilities.title: Declare numeric properties
capabilities.outcome: A component author can expose numeric inputs with units, ranges and step values, and instance editors reject values outside that contract.

capabilities.title: Declare boolean properties
capabilities.outcome: An author can expose a switch whose true and false behaviors are visible in preview without converting absent values into implicit overrides.

capabilities.title: Declare enumerated properties
capabilities.outcome: A component author defines a finite option set with stable option keys, preventing renamed labels from breaking stored instance selections.

capabilities.title: Declare link properties
capabilities.outcome: An author exposes link targets with allowed schemes and optional link text, and previews the resulting destination before accepting an instance value.

capabilities.title: Declare image properties
capabilities.outcome: A component author exposes an asset reference together with its alternative-text contract so replacing an image preserves explicit accessibility choices.

capabilities.title: Declare rich-text properties
capabilities.outcome: An author exposes a constrained rich-text input whose allowed marks and embedded objects remain consistent between the editor and rendered component.

capabilities.title: Declare structured object properties
capabilities.outcome: An author defines a bounded typed object input whose nested field errors point to exact property paths without accepting unknown fields silently.

capabilities.title: Declare list properties
capabilities.outcome: A component author exposes a typed list with minimum and maximum item counts, stable item identities and predictable local reordering behavior.

capabilities.title: Mark required properties
capabilities.outcome: An author marks inputs required and receives an instance-level validation summary that identifies missing values before a local release can include them.

capabilities.title: Inspect property default provenance
capabilities.outcome: An instance inspector distinguishes a definition default from an explicit local override, including empty text, zero and false as intentional values.

capabilities.title: Reset individual property overrides
capabilities.outcome: An author can reset one instance property to its current definition default without altering other overrides or unrelated component instances.

capabilities.title: Rename property display labels
capabilities.outcome: Changing a property's editor label preserves its stable storage key and all instance values while updating the visible authoring controls.

capabilities.title: Preview property key migrations
capabilities.outcome: Before changing a property's storage key, a migration preview lists affected instance values and explicit mapping choices without applying data changes.

capabilities.title: Hide advanced property controls
capabilities.outcome: Definition authors can group advanced inputs behind a disclosed section while retaining searchable labels and complete validation visibility for populated overrides.

capabilities.title: Order property editor controls
capabilities.outcome: An author can reorder property controls in the instance editor without changing the component's rendered structure or serialized input identities.

capabilities.title: Add property descriptions
capabilities.outcome: Definition authors can attach plain-language help and valid examples to an input, with descriptions associated with the corresponding editor control.

capabilities.title: Inspect property consumer nodes
capabilities.outcome: Selecting a property shows the internal nodes or behaviors that consume it, making shared input effects understandable before changing an instance.

capabilities.title: Validate nested component inputs
capabilities.outcome: A parent component can map approved property values into a nested component, with incompatible types rejected at the exact mapping boundary.

capabilities.title: Export property schema documentation
capabilities.outcome: A local export describes property types, defaults, required constraints and stable keys, excluding instance secrets and unsupported executable validation code.

families.name: Component slots and composition
families.scope: Compose component instances through declared slots whose allowed content, cardinality and fallback behavior are explicit.
families.refusal: Refuse composition cycles, prohibited node types, over-capacity slots and moves across source ownership or slot boundaries without support.
families.recovery: Keep moved content identities and prior slot assignments in the command snapshot so failed composition or Undo restores the exact arrangement.
families.feedback: Identify slot boundaries, accepted content, occupied counts and fallback rendering in both canvas and hierarchy views.
families.evidence: Test empty, single, repeated and nested slots with incompatible content and verify source, document and selection identities remain consistent.

capabilities.title: Declare named component slots
capabilities.outcome: A definition author creates a stable named insertion point that appears in the hierarchy and accepts only explicitly supported content categories.

capabilities.title: Restrict slot component types
capabilities.outcome: An author can limit a slot to selected component definitions and receives a clear refusal before inserting an incompatible component instance.

capabilities.title: Set slot cardinality limits
capabilities.outcome: An author defines minimum and maximum slot occupancy, and the builder reports missing or excess children without silently removing content.

capabilities.title: Define slot fallback content
capabilities.outcome: A component can provide default slot content that renders only when no explicit instance content is assigned to that slot.

capabilities.title: Inspect slot ownership boundaries
capabilities.outcome: Selecting projected content shows whether its nodes belong to the containing page, component definition or nested instance before editing actions appear.

capabilities.title: Navigate nested slot paths
capabilities.outcome: The hierarchy shows the full component-and-slot path to deeply projected content, allowing selection without flattening nested ownership relationships.

capabilities.title: Insert content into empty slots
capabilities.outcome: An author chooses an eligible node or component for an empty slot and previews insertion position and resulting fallback replacement.

capabilities.title: Move content between slots
capabilities.outcome: A guarded move retains node identity while validating the destination slot contract, and refuses the operation without changing either slot on failure.

capabilities.title: Reorder repeated slot children
capabilities.outcome: An author reorders children within a repeated slot using keyboard or pointer controls, preserving their identities and associated local input values.

capabilities.title: Clear slot assignments explicitly
capabilities.outcome: A confirmation preview lists the projected content affected by clearing a slot and distinguishes removal from restoring definition fallback content.

capabilities.title: Restore slot fallback rendering
capabilities.outcome: An author can remove an explicit slot override so the current fallback becomes visible, with the resulting content scope explained before acceptance.

capabilities.title: Expose slots as insertion targets
capabilities.outcome: Eligible empty slots appear as named targets in the insertion chooser, with restrictions displayed before the author commits to a destination.

capabilities.title: Preview slot content constraints
capabilities.outcome: A preview mode shows slot boundaries and allowed child categories without adding permanent wrapper elements to the generated component structure.

capabilities.title: Preserve slot assignments on updates
capabilities.outcome: A definition update retains instance slot content by stable slot identity and reports unmapped assignments before a migration can be accepted.

capabilities.title: Rename slot display labels
capabilities.outcome: Changing a slot's visible name updates authoring labels while preserving its storage key, projected content references and instance composition history.

capabilities.title: Migrate removed slot assignments
capabilities.outcome: Removing a populated slot requires an explicit destination or detach decision for every assignment, with no silent content loss during migration.

capabilities.title: Detect slot composition cycles
capabilities.outcome: The builder identifies recursive component projection paths and explains the precise definition and slot references responsible before insertion is rejected.

capabilities.title: Inspect slot accessibility semantics
capabilities.outcome: A slot inspector reports the semantic container and landmark constraints that projected content must respect, including invalid nested interactive content.

capabilities.title: Preview slot empty states
capabilities.outcome: Authors can render declared empty-slot states across component variants and viewports without changing saved instance assignments or fallback definitions.

capabilities.title: Export slot contracts
capabilities.outcome: A local component contract export lists slot identities, allowed children, cardinality and fallback references so an importer can validate composition compatibility.

families.name: Component variants and conditional structure
families.scope: Model named component variants and finite conditional branches without hiding ownership or silently changing instance values.
families.refusal: Refuse conflicting variant keys, invalid condition references and conditional branches that depend on undeclared or executable expressions.
families.recovery: Restore prior variant selections and branch configuration from versioned commands while keeping deliberately retained inactive content intact.
families.feedback: Show active variants, inherited choices and inactive branch reasons through explicit labels in canvas and inspector views.
families.evidence: Use combinations of variant axes and conditional branches to verify deterministic rendering, preserved values and bounded preview coverage.

capabilities.title: Define named component variants
capabilities.outcome: A definition author creates named variants with stable identities and explicit structural or stylistic differences from the component's base definition.

capabilities.title: Choose instance variants
capabilities.outcome: An instance editor lets the author select an available variant and previews its effects while preserving unrelated property and slot values.

capabilities.title: Define multiple variant axes
capabilities.outcome: A component can declare independent axes such as size and emphasis, with valid combinations represented as structured selections instead of concatenated names.

capabilities.title: Inspect inherited variant choices
capabilities.outcome: The inspector distinguishes a definition's default variant from an explicit instance selection, including which default will apply after an override reset.

capabilities.title: Preview variant comparison grids
capabilities.outcome: Authors can render selected variants side by side with shared fixture inputs, making differences visible without creating permanent page instances.

capabilities.title: Validate disallowed variant combinations
capabilities.outcome: A definition can declare incompatible axis combinations, and instance editing explains the conflict before accepting any invalid selection.

capabilities.title: Reset instance variant overrides
capabilities.outcome: An author can restore one instance's variant choices to current defaults without clearing its content properties or projected slot children.

capabilities.title: Define property-driven branch rules
capabilities.outcome: A component author maps declared boolean or enum inputs to finite branch choices, with the rule represented as data rather than arbitrary code.

capabilities.title: Inspect inactive branch reasons
capabilities.outcome: Selecting a conditionally absent region shows the property and variant conditions suppressing it, without claiming the inactive region is currently rendered.

capabilities.title: Retain inactive branch content
capabilities.outcome: Switching conditional branches preserves their configured local content so revisiting a branch does not recreate nodes or erase deliberate edits.

capabilities.title: Preview conditional empty content
capabilities.outcome: Authors can preview a branch with missing optional values and verify whether declared fallback, omission or error behavior will occur.

capabilities.title: Define variant-specific property defaults
capabilities.outcome: A definition can supply explicit defaults for a variant, and the inspector identifies whether a value comes from base or selected variant configuration.

capabilities.title: Compare variant source ownership
capabilities.outcome: The inspector separates document-owned variant structure from externally authored source variants, keeping unsupported edits read-only and visibly labeled.

capabilities.title: Rename variant display names
capabilities.outcome: Renaming a variant changes visible editor labels while retaining its stable selection key and all existing instance references in local documents.

capabilities.title: Preview variant removal migrations
capabilities.outcome: Removing a used variant requires a replacement or explicit instance override plan, with affected pages listed before the migration is accepted.

capabilities.title: Constrain slot availability by variant
capabilities.outcome: A definition can vary declared slot availability while preserving inactive assignments and validating any content that becomes visible in the selected variant.

capabilities.title: Inspect responsive variant selection
capabilities.outcome: Authors can view how explicit viewport-specific variant choices resolve, with the active override and inherited fallback identified for each preview width.

capabilities.title: Record variant preview fixtures
capabilities.outcome: A component stores named synthetic input sets for variant previews so future definition changes can be compared against the same declared scenarios.

capabilities.title: Detect untested variant combinations
capabilities.outcome: The builder identifies declared variant combinations missing from the component's local preview fixture matrix without claiming they passed visual verification.

capabilities.title: Export variant selection contracts
capabilities.outcome: A local export describes variant axes, defaults, valid combinations and finite conditions so compatible consumers can reproduce selection semantics.

families.name: Component library versions and migrations
families.scope: Manage local component library releases, explicit dependency versions and reviewed migrations without implying remote package publication.
families.refusal: Refuse dependency cycles, incompatible imports, missing artifacts and version updates that bypass a complete instance migration preview.
families.recovery: Retain the installed local library version and migration snapshot until a replacement is validated, with exact rollback scope documented.
families.feedback: Show installed, available and proposed versions separately, including migration effects, unsupported features and source ownership conflicts.
families.evidence: Use two versioned fixture libraries with breaking property and slot changes to verify pinning, migration, conflict refusal and rollback.

capabilities.title: Create local component libraries
capabilities.outcome: An author groups selected definitions into a named local library with stable library identity and explicit ownership of included component records.

capabilities.title: Create immutable library releases
capabilities.outcome: A release command captures component definitions, contracts and dependency versions in an immutable local artifact tied to its source revision.

capabilities.title: Pin page library versions
capabilities.outcome: A page can depend on a specific local library release, preventing an unrelated newer release from silently changing its component instances.

capabilities.title: Inspect library dependency versions
capabilities.outcome: The library inspector lists exact component and nested library versions used by a release, distinguishing compatible ranges from resolved local artifacts.

capabilities.title: Compare library releases
capabilities.outcome: Authors can compare two releases by component identities, property contracts, slots, variants and dependencies before selecting a proposed upgrade.

capabilities.title: Preview library upgrade effects
capabilities.outcome: An upgrade preview identifies affected pages and instances, required migrations and unsupported changes without modifying any installed local library version.

capabilities.title: Map renamed component properties
capabilities.outcome: A migration editor maps old property keys to new keys with type checks and explicit handling for values that cannot be converted.

capabilities.title: Map renamed component slots
capabilities.outcome: A library migration maps stable old slot assignments into declared new slots, identifying overflow and incompatible projected content before any commit.

capabilities.title: Resolve removed component definitions
capabilities.outcome: An upgrade containing removed definitions requires explicit replacement or detach choices for affected instances rather than silently dropping them from pages.

capabilities.title: Apply reviewed library migrations
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed migration atomically updates selected library dependencies and affected instances only after validating the exact reviewed source and target revisions.

capabilities.title: Rollback local library upgrades
capabilities.outcome: An author can restore the prior library artifact and its associated instance values within the recorded rollback scope without reverting unrelated page changes.

capabilities.title: Import compatible library manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local library import validates version, schema, ownership and referenced artifacts before exposing eligible definitions in the component insertion chooser.

capabilities.title: Detect library identity collisions
capabilities.outcome: An import with conflicting library or component identities reports the collision and requires an explicit namespace mapping or refusal before data changes.

capabilities.title: Namespace imported component libraries
capabilities.outcome: Authors can assign a stable local namespace to an imported library while preserving its original identities and provenance in the import record.

capabilities.title: Inspect library portability gaps
capabilities.outcome: A release inspector reports source-only components, unsupported slots, external assets and runtime requirements that a chosen local export target cannot reproduce.

capabilities.title: Search library contract metadata
capabilities.outcome: The component library search filters names, tags, properties, slots and declared capabilities without indexing instance text or arbitrary source bodies.

capabilities.title: Track deprecated library definitions
capabilities.outcome: A library author marks definitions deprecated with replacement guidance, while existing instances remain usable and new insertion warnings identify the recommended successor.

capabilities.title: Preview library licensing metadata
capabilities.outcome: A local library record can show its declared license and provenance references, with missing declarations visible without asserting legal approval or ownership.

capabilities.title: Export reviewed library bundles
capabilities.outcome: An author exports a selected immutable library release with contracts and local artifacts, accompanied by a manifest that identifies excluded provider-bound dependencies.

capabilities.title: Validate reproducible library artifacts
capabilities.outcome: Rebuilding a local release from identical declared inputs produces the same normalized manifest and artifact digests, with nondeterministic differences reported explicitly.

families.name: Asset library metadata and reference management
families.scope: Catalog local assets with content identities, provenance and usage references while keeping runtime paths and credentials outside reusable records.
families.refusal: Refuse traversal, secret-bearing metadata, unsupported file types and destructive replacement of assets with unresolved usage or ownership.
families.recovery: Retain prior asset records and reference mappings so replacement or archive commands can be undone without losing referenced local artifacts.
families.feedback: Expose asset identity, type, usage, source ownership and missing-file states with explicit labels and navigable references.
families.evidence: Use duplicate bytes, renamed files, missing artifacts and shared references to verify stable identity, scoped replacement and recovery.

capabilities.title: Register local assets
capabilities.outcome: An author can register an eligible repository asset with a stable content identity, bounded metadata and an explicit source ownership classification.

capabilities.title: Inspect asset usage references
capabilities.outcome: An asset inspector lists pages, component definitions and CMS fields referencing the selected asset, using stable object identifiers and bounded labels.

capabilities.title: Search asset metadata
capabilities.outcome: The asset library supports searching filenames, declared titles, tags and media types without opening arbitrary file contents or reading private runtime directories.

capabilities.title: Tag local assets
capabilities.outcome: Authors can assign reusable metadata tags to selected assets and filter the library by those tags without moving the underlying source files.

capabilities.title: Detect duplicate asset bytes
capabilities.outcome: The library identifies assets with identical content digests and explains their separate references before any explicit deduplication mapping is proposed.

capabilities.title: Rename asset display titles
capabilities.outcome: Changing an asset's library title updates authoring labels while preserving its stable identity, source path and every existing usage reference.

capabilities.title: Inspect asset provenance
capabilities.outcome: The inspector displays declared creator, source and license references separately from verified file identity, making missing provenance explicit rather than inferred.

capabilities.title: Preview asset replacement scope
capabilities.outcome: Before replacing an asset, a review lists all affected references and compatibility constraints while leaving their current artifact mappings unchanged.

capabilities.title: Replace compatible local assets
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed replacement updates only the reviewed references to a compatible new asset revision and retains the previous artifact for recovery.

capabilities.title: Archive unreferenced assets
capabilities.outcome: An author can archive an asset with no active references, removing it from default insertion choices while retaining recoverable metadata and history.

capabilities.title: Restore archived assets
capabilities.outcome: An archived local asset can return under its original identity when its artifact is available and no conflicting active registry record exists.

capabilities.title: Detect missing asset artifacts
capabilities.outcome: The library marks registered assets whose declared files are missing and lists affected consumers without silently substituting another file with a matching name.

capabilities.title: Repair moved asset references
capabilities.outcome: An author can review a proposed mapping from missing files to moved local assets using content identity, with ambiguous matches requiring explicit resolution.

capabilities.title: Inspect asset metadata privacy
capabilities.outcome: The asset editor shows which metadata fields are exported and warns when proposed public descriptions contain prohibited secret-shaped values before saving.

capabilities.title: Group assets into collections
capabilities.outcome: Authors can create named logical asset collections for reusable projects or components without duplicating files or creating nested source directories automatically.

capabilities.title: Export asset reference manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local export lists asset identities, relative artifact paths, media types and declared provenance, excluding machine-specific paths and runtime credentials.

capabilities.title: Import asset manifest previews
capabilities.outcome: A manifest import previews new assets, existing content matches and identity conflicts before any registry or source artifact changes are authorized.

capabilities.title: Inspect asset storage budgets
capabilities.outcome: The library reports selected assets' known byte sizes and aggregate export impact, identifying unavailable measurements instead of estimating them as verified facts.

capabilities.title: Filter assets by source ownership
capabilities.outcome: Authors can filter generated, source-owned and imported-reference assets so available replacement operations follow the selected ownership and adapter capabilities.

capabilities.title: Verify asset references before release
capabilities.outcome: A local release check reports missing or incompatible asset references by consuming object and blocks only the declared required assets within that release scope.

families.name: Image renditions and responsive media
families.scope: Author local image presentation, deterministic rendition recipes and responsive selection contracts without silently modifying source originals.
families.refusal: Refuse unsupported decoding, invalid crop bounds, unsafe SVG behavior and destructive processing that lacks a retained original artifact.
families.recovery: Keep image originals and prior recipes addressable so failed rendition generation or Undo restores the previous selected artifact and settings.
families.feedback: Show original versus generated artifacts, crop coordinates, intrinsic dimensions and the active responsive selection in preview.
families.evidence: Use portrait, landscape, transparent, oversized and corrupt synthetic images to verify crop geometry, responsive selection and deterministic artifacts.

capabilities.title: Inspect intrinsic image dimensions
capabilities.outcome: An author can inspect verified intrinsic dimensions and orientation for a supported local image, with unavailable or failed decoding shown explicitly.

capabilities.title: Define non-destructive image crops
capabilities.outcome: An author selects crop coordinates as a local recipe and previews the result while preserving the original image artifact unchanged.

capabilities.title: Set image focal points
capabilities.outcome: A focal point stored separately from crop bounds guides responsive image framing, with the resolved visible region shown at selected viewport widths.

capabilities.title: Generate declared image renditions
capabilities.outcome: A local processing command creates only the explicitly requested sizes and formats, recording source digest and recipe inputs for every generated rendition.

capabilities.title: Choose responsive image sources
capabilities.outcome: An author defines responsive source candidates and size hints, and preview identifies which candidate a browser actually selects at the current device width.

capabilities.title: Preserve image transparency
capabilities.outcome: A rendition recipe declares whether transparency must be preserved, and incompatible output formats require an explicit background treatment before generation.

capabilities.title: Configure image fit behavior
capabilities.outcome: Authors choose supported contain or cover behavior and preview clipping against a real container without altering intrinsic source dimensions or crop recipes.

capabilities.title: Set image loading priority
capabilities.outcome: An author declares loading and decoding hints for an image instance, with the preview inspector showing the resulting attributes and any conflicting choices.

capabilities.title: Declare decorative image intent
capabilities.outcome: An image instance can be marked decorative explicitly, and its rendered alternative text behavior follows that choice without changing other uses of the asset.

capabilities.title: Author contextual image alternatives
capabilities.outcome: Different uses of one image can carry distinct alternative text values, and the inspector separates those contextual values from asset-level metadata.

capabilities.title: Inspect image export cost
capabilities.outcome: A comparison shows measured byte sizes and dimensions for generated candidates so authors can choose a rendition without relying on unsupported quality scores.

capabilities.title: Preview image aspect-ratio constraints
capabilities.outcome: An image instance can declare an aspect ratio that reserves layout space, with preview showing how fit and crop settings interact within that box.

capabilities.title: Validate image processing limits
capabilities.outcome: The local generator rejects images or recipes beyond declared pixel, file-size and output-count limits before producing partial replacement artifacts.

capabilities.title: Inspect image orientation normalization
capabilities.outcome: The image inspector shows detected orientation and any planned normalization, allowing the author to compare the rendered result with the preserved original.

capabilities.title: Generate deterministic image placeholders
capabilities.outcome: Authors can create bounded local placeholder artifacts from declared images and recipes, with provenance retained and no external image service required.

capabilities.title: Preview missing image fallbacks
capabilities.outcome: A controlled preview can render a declared fallback for a missing image reference while keeping the missing primary asset visible in diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Inspect image color-profile handling
capabilities.outcome: The processing recipe records how supported color profiles are retained or normalized, and unsupported profile behavior is disclosed before accepting generated output.

capabilities.title: Compare image rendition revisions
capabilities.outcome: Authors can compare prior and proposed image recipes and artifacts side by side, with source, crop and dimension changes identified separately.

capabilities.title: Remove unused image renditions
capabilities.outcome: A reviewed cleanup command removes only generated renditions with no active references and preserves the original image plus any retained rollback artifacts.

capabilities.title: Export image recipe manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local image export includes source content identities, crop and rendition recipes, responsive candidates and required artifacts without embedding machine-specific processing paths.

families.name: Video audio and timed media
families.scope: Compose supported local video and audio assets with explicit playback, caption and fallback contracts in the preview.
families.refusal: Refuse unapproved remote embeds, unsupported media operations, unsafe autoplay combinations and caption references that cannot be resolved.
families.recovery: Preserve source media, timing metadata and prior track mappings so failed edits or local Undo do not discard accessible playback configurations.
families.feedback: Expose playback state, unavailable formats, caption selection and missing transcript or poster information without inferring media accessibility compliance.
families.evidence: Use short synthetic media with multiple tracks, invalid timestamps and unavailable assets to verify controls, fallback behavior and bounded metadata.

capabilities.title: Register timed media assets
capabilities.outcome: An author can register a supported local audio or video artifact with verified media type and explicitly available duration and dimension metadata.

capabilities.title: Choose video poster images
capabilities.outcome: A video instance can reference a local poster asset, with the inspector separating poster accessibility metadata from the video's caption and transcript configuration.

capabilities.title: Configure explicit playback controls
capabilities.outcome: Authors can choose supported playback controls and preview their visible state, while unavailable controls are reported rather than represented as functional buttons.

capabilities.title: Declare muted autoplay intent
capabilities.outcome: A media instance can request muted autoplay, and preview reports the actual browser playback outcome without treating requested autoplay as successful playback.

capabilities.title: Attach caption tracks
capabilities.outcome: An author associates supported local caption files with a media instance using stable track identities, language tags and explicit default-track selection.

capabilities.title: Validate caption timestamp order
capabilities.outcome: The caption editor reports malformed or overlapping timing sequences at exact cue locations before accepting a proposed local track revision.

capabilities.title: Edit caption cue text
capabilities.outcome: Authors can change cue text through a bounded editor that preserves cue identities and timing, with preview synchronized to the selected media position.

capabilities.title: Attach media transcripts
capabilities.outcome: A media record can reference a local transcript with explicit language and publication scope, independent from timed caption tracks and poster metadata.

capabilities.title: Define chapter markers
capabilities.outcome: An author can create ordered named media chapters within verified duration bounds, and preview navigation seeks to the corresponding supported playback position.

capabilities.title: Select default media tracks
capabilities.outcome: An author chooses a valid default caption or audio track from declared candidates, and conflicting defaults are rejected before the instance configuration changes.

capabilities.title: Preview media loading failures
capabilities.outcome: Controlled preview scenarios show unavailable local media and captions using declared fallback messages without making actual source artifacts missing or changing saved references.

capabilities.title: Inspect playback compatibility
capabilities.outcome: The inspector lists known local media formats and actual preview load results separately, avoiding unsupported claims about every target device or browser.

capabilities.title: Declare playback loop ranges
capabilities.outcome: A supported local preview can loop an explicit valid time range, with range controls disabled when duration or seeking capability cannot be verified.

capabilities.title: Configure media preload intent
capabilities.outcome: An author selects supported preload hints and sees the rendered configuration, distinguishing those hints from observed network loading or browser caching behavior.

capabilities.title: Restrict remote media embeds
capabilities.outcome: A component can declare an approved embed adapter and allowed source pattern, with arbitrary URLs remaining unembedded and clearly unavailable in local preview.

capabilities.title: Preview reduced-motion media behavior
capabilities.outcome: A media component can define reduced-motion presentation choices, and preview shows the selected alternative without assuming that captions or transcripts are optional.

capabilities.title: Inspect media reference usage
capabilities.outcome: The media library lists consuming pages, components and CMS entries before replacement, including dependent poster, caption, chapter and transcript records.

capabilities.title: Replace compatible media revisions
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed replacement validates dependent timing and track references, and requires explicit resolution for metadata that falls outside the new media duration.

capabilities.title: Compare media configuration revisions
capabilities.outcome: Authors can compare playback settings and timed metadata between local revisions without re-encoding media or changing the selected page's instance values.

capabilities.title: Export media delivery manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local export lists media artifacts, posters, tracks, transcripts and playback requirements, identifying unavailable or provider-bound assets before packaging.

families.name: Documents icons and downloadable assets
families.scope: Manage downloadable documents, vector symbols and file presentation using safe local references and explicit export metadata.
families.refusal: Refuse executable downloads, unsafe inline vector constructs, path traversal and transformations that claim accessibility or document fidelity without evidence.
families.recovery: Retain original files and prior presentation records so replacement, archive or conversion failures can be restored without changing unrelated downloads.
families.feedback: Show file type, measured size, declared language, download destination and unsupported preview or conversion features in the inspector.
families.evidence: Use synthetic PDFs, text documents, SVG symbols and missing files to verify safe previews, preserved originals and correct link metadata.

capabilities.title: Register downloadable documents
capabilities.outcome: An author can register an eligible local document with content identity, media type and a declared download label without uploading it to a provider.

capabilities.title: Configure download link labels
capabilities.outcome: Each document link can carry contextual visible text and accessible naming, with preview showing the exact destination and resulting link behavior.

capabilities.title: Inspect document file metadata
capabilities.outcome: The asset inspector shows verified file size and supported metadata fields, distinguishing declared title or language from information extracted from the file.

capabilities.title: Preview supported document pages
capabilities.outcome: The builder can display a bounded preview of supported local document pages while preserving the original file and reporting unsupported rendering features explicitly.

capabilities.title: Declare document language metadata
capabilities.outcome: An author can store a declared document language and use it in download presentation without rewriting embedded document metadata or asserting language verification.

capabilities.title: Replace downloadable document revisions
capabilities.outcome: A replacement preview lists affected links and compatibility warnings before switching their references to a new retained document revision.

capabilities.title: Detect broken download references
capabilities.outcome: A release inspection identifies download links whose referenced artifact is missing, with page and component identifiers that lead to the affected link instances.

capabilities.title: Configure download filename intent
capabilities.outcome: An author can propose a safe download filename for a document link, and unsupported browser or cross-origin behavior is disclosed in the preview contract.

capabilities.title: Register reusable vector symbols
capabilities.outcome: An eligible local vector symbol can be registered with a stable identity and bounded view-box metadata for reuse through an approved rendering adapter.

capabilities.title: Inspect vector safety findings
capabilities.outcome: The vector inspector reports unsupported scripts, external references or active constructs before inline rendering is allowed, keeping the original artifact unchanged.

capabilities.title: Choose icon accessibility intent
capabilities.outcome: An icon instance can declare decorative or informative intent, with the corresponding rendered labels visible independently from the symbol's library title.

capabilities.title: Set vector sizing contracts
capabilities.outcome: A reusable icon can declare supported sizing and aspect-ratio behavior, and preview shows how the symbol resolves within the selected component container.

capabilities.title: Preview vector theme tokens
capabilities.outcome: An approved vector adapter can expose declared theme-token bindings, with unsupported hard-coded colors identified rather than silently rewritten in arbitrary source.

capabilities.title: Inspect icon instance references
capabilities.outcome: The library lists every consuming local icon instance before symbol replacement, preserving contextual labels and ownership boundaries during navigation.

capabilities.title: Package downloadable asset groups
capabilities.outcome: An author can prepare a local download group containing explicitly selected eligible artifacts, with a deterministic manifest and no runtime or secret directories included.

capabilities.title: Verify download artifact integrity
capabilities.outcome: A local release check compares referenced downloadable files with their recorded content digests and reports changed artifacts before packaging continues.

capabilities.title: Declare document preview fallbacks
capabilities.outcome: Authors can define a readable fallback link and file summary for documents whose local preview format is unavailable or cannot be rendered safely.

capabilities.title: Inspect document accessibility declarations
capabilities.outcome: The document inspector shows declared accessibility status and evidence references separately from file rendering, without converting a successful preview into compliance approval.

capabilities.title: Archive unused download assets
capabilities.outcome: A reviewed archive operation hides unreferenced downloadable assets from default insertion choices while preserving their identities, history and recoverable original files.

capabilities.title: Export download asset manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local export lists relative artifact references, safe filenames, media types and contextual presentation requirements, excluding credentials and absolute host filesystem paths.

families.name: CMS collection schemas and field definitions
families.scope: Define versioned local collection schemas and typed fields before binding synthetic records or adopting a provider adapter.
families.refusal: Refuse duplicate field keys, incompatible values, destructive schema changes without migration and unsupported executable field logic.
families.recovery: Keep schema versions and corresponding record snapshots together so failed migrations or Undo restore a coherent collection state.
families.feedback: Show field types, constraints, defaults, references and affected record counts with actionable validation paths.
families.evidence: Use synthetic collections containing valid, missing, legacy and incompatible values to verify schema evolution without silent data loss.

capabilities.title: Create local collection schemas
capabilities.outcome: An author creates a named local collection schema with a stable identity, explicit version and declared fields before any records are bound to preview.

capabilities.title: Define plain-text CMS fields
capabilities.outcome: A schema author defines text fields with explicit required and length constraints, and record editors identify values that violate the declared contract.

capabilities.title: Define rich-text CMS fields
capabilities.outcome: A collection schema can allow a constrained rich-text structure with supported marks and embeds, rejecting unsupported document shapes at exact field paths.

capabilities.title: Define numeric CMS fields
capabilities.outcome: An author declares numeric fields with range, precision and unit metadata, preserving zero as a valid value rather than treating it as missing content.

capabilities.title: Define boolean CMS fields
capabilities.outcome: A collection can store explicit true and false values with a documented absence rule, and editors preserve the distinction between false and unset.

capabilities.title: Define date and time fields
capabilities.outcome: A schema declares date-only or timestamp semantics explicitly, and editors display timezone interpretation without silently converting one field kind into the other.

capabilities.title: Define enumerated CMS fields
capabilities.outcome: An author creates finite options with stable stored keys and editable display labels, so renaming a label does not invalidate existing records.

capabilities.title: Define CMS media-reference fields
capabilities.outcome: A schema can require references to eligible local asset kinds, and record editors reject references whose target type does not satisfy the field contract.

capabilities.title: Define structured CMS object fields
capabilities.outcome: A schema author declares bounded nested objects with typed child fields, and validation returns exact paths for missing or incompatible nested values.

capabilities.title: Define ordered CMS list fields
capabilities.outcome: A collection can store typed ordered lists with stable item identities and declared length bounds, supporting reordering without replacing unrelated list values.

capabilities.title: Declare CMS field defaults
capabilities.outcome: An author defines explicit defaults for new records, with existing records retaining their saved values until a reviewed migration deliberately applies defaults.

capabilities.title: Declare CMS field uniqueness
capabilities.outcome: A local schema can require unique normalized values within its collection scope, and conflicting records are identified before a save is accepted.

capabilities.title: Inspect schema field usage
capabilities.outcome: Selecting a field lists its local template, binding, validation and query consumers, making removal or type changes understandable before migration planning.

capabilities.title: Rename CMS field labels
capabilities.outcome: Changing a field's editor label preserves its stable storage key and all saved records, while updating the labels used by compatible editor controls.

capabilities.title: Preview CMS field key migrations
capabilities.outcome: An author can review key mappings and affected records before a field identifier changes, with ambiguous or unmapped values requiring explicit resolution.

capabilities.title: Preview CMS field type migrations
capabilities.outcome: A proposed type change shows convertible values, failures and retained originals, refusing acceptance until every affected record has a declared migration outcome.

capabilities.title: Archive unused CMS fields
capabilities.outcome: A field with no active consumers can be archived from default editing views while its historical schema versions and stored values remain recoverable.

capabilities.title: Version collection schemas
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed schema change advances a local version and records its compatibility and migration requirements, without implying that any provider schema was published.

capabilities.title: Export collection schema contracts
capabilities.outcome: A local export describes field identities, types, constraints and migration references in a portable schema manifest without including provider credentials or private records.

capabilities.title: Compare collection schema revisions
capabilities.outcome: An author can compare two schema versions by added, removed, renamed and constrained fields, with affected local consumers shown independently from raw JSON formatting.

families.name: CMS references relations and integrity
families.scope: Model typed local record relationships, inverse lookup and deletion consequences while preserving referential integrity.
families.refusal: Refuse dangling or cross-scope references, forbidden cycles and deletes whose declared reference consequences remain unresolved.
families.recovery: Capture affected records and relation edges in one local command snapshot so rejection or Undo restores a coherent graph.
families.feedback: Expose relationship direction, allowed targets, broken references and affected consumers before editing or deletion.
families.evidence: Use synthetic one-to-one, one-to-many, ordered and cyclic graphs to verify exact relation validation, deletion previews and graph recovery.

capabilities.title: Define single-record references
capabilities.outcome: A schema author declares a reference to one eligible record in a named local collection, with missing and incompatible targets rejected explicitly.

capabilities.title: Define multi-record references
capabilities.outcome: A collection can store a bounded ordered set of record references whose target types and duplicate policy are enforced during local editing.

capabilities.title: Inspect incoming record references
capabilities.outcome: A record inspector lists local records, templates and bindings that reference it, allowing navigation without exposing unrelated private field content.

capabilities.title: Preview referenced record summaries
capabilities.outcome: A reference editor displays a schema-approved summary of each eligible target, with missing summaries distinguished from missing or inaccessible target records.

capabilities.title: Filter reference picker candidates
capabilities.outcome: Authors can restrict a reference picker using declared local query conditions, while the underlying schema continues to validate the final selected target.

capabilities.title: Define relationship cardinality
capabilities.outcome: A relation contract can require one-to-one or bounded one-to-many ownership, and conflicting relationships are identified before any local graph change is accepted.

capabilities.title: Inspect inverse relationship views
capabilities.outcome: A local derived view shows records pointing to the current record without creating duplicate stored inverse edges or treating the view as independent source data.

capabilities.title: Preview referenced record deletion
capabilities.outcome: Before deleting a referenced record, the builder lists affected edges and permitted retain, reject, detach or replacement choices within the declared schema policy.

capabilities.title: Replace reference targets atomically
capabilities.outcome: An author can confirm a target replacement across a reviewed set of local edges, and validation rejects the whole change when any resulting relation is invalid.

capabilities.title: Reorder referenced record lists
capabilities.outcome: An author can reorder an ordered multi-reference field while preserving record identities, other field values and relationship membership outside the selected list.

capabilities.title: Validate required relationship targets
capabilities.outcome: A local validation report identifies records whose required reference target is absent or unavailable, with precise collection and field identifiers for repair.

capabilities.title: Detect forbidden relationship cycles
capabilities.outcome: A schema can prohibit cycles for selected relationship types, and edits explain the concrete record path responsible for a rejected cycle.

capabilities.title: Bound recursive relation traversal
capabilities.outcome: A relation explorer discloses depth and node limits when traversing large graphs, preserving incomplete-result warnings instead of presenting truncated discovery as complete.

capabilities.title: Inspect relationship scope boundaries
capabilities.outcome: The relation editor explains whether a target belongs to the current fixture workspace or an external reference, keeping unsupported cross-workspace writes unavailable.

capabilities.title: Preview schema relation migrations
capabilities.outcome: A migration preview shows how changed target collections or cardinality constraints affect existing relation edges before any records are transformed.

capabilities.title: Repair imported unresolved references
capabilities.outcome: An import workflow lets an author map unresolved external identifiers to eligible local records, refusing ambiguous matches until every required relation is resolved.

capabilities.title: Distinguish missing and denied references
capabilities.outcome: A binding preview can represent a missing target separately from an intentionally unavailable target, without revealing protected metadata through diagnostic labels.

capabilities.title: Export relationship graph manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local export includes stable record and relation identities with declared target schemas, preserving edge order and reference scope for compatible importers.

capabilities.title: Validate relation graph snapshots
capabilities.outcome: A snapshot check verifies every required local edge resolves against its captured collection versions before the snapshot can become a restore candidate.

capabilities.title: Restore relation graphs coherently
capabilities.outcome: A local restore command validates selected collections and relation edges together, rejecting partial restoration that would produce dangling required references.

families.name: CMS query and canvas bindings
families.scope: Bind canonical nodes and approved component properties to typed synthetic collection queries with explicit missing-data and ownership behavior.
families.refusal: Refuse incompatible type bindings, unsupported source-owned targets, arbitrary executable expressions and unbounded or unauthorized data traversal.
families.recovery: Preserve prior binding definitions and fixture selections so a rejected edit or Undo restores the same query and rendered data scope.
families.feedback: Show binding source, query arguments, resolved type, empty state and ownership without exposing hidden field values in general diagnostics.
families.evidence: Use deterministic fixtures with empty, malformed, related and inaccessible records to verify exact binding results and bounded rendering.

capabilities.title: Bind text nodes to CMS fields
capabilities.outcome: An author connects an eligible text node to a compatible collection field and previews the selected record value without copying it into source literals.

capabilities.title: Bind image instances to CMS assets
capabilities.outcome: A supported image target can resolve its asset and contextual alternative text from declared CMS fields, with incompatible asset types reported before binding acceptance.

capabilities.title: Bind links to CMS destinations
capabilities.outcome: An author maps a compatible CMS URL or local route reference into a link target, preserving allowed-scheme checks and declared fallback behavior.

capabilities.title: Bind component properties to fields
capabilities.outcome: An eligible component input can consume a compatible CMS field, with the inspector identifying schema type, instance scope and any explicit conversion.

capabilities.title: Bind repeated component collections
capabilities.outcome: An author binds a repeated component region to a bounded local collection query while keeping each rendered record's instance identity stable.

capabilities.title: Configure collection query filters
capabilities.outcome: A binding editor supports declared typed predicates for a local collection and previews matching record counts before applying the query to a canvas region.

capabilities.title: Configure collection query sorting
capabilities.outcome: An author chooses stable sort keys and tie-breakers, and preview shows the resulting order without mutating the stored source collection sequence.

capabilities.title: Configure collection query limits
capabilities.outcome: A binding declares an explicit maximum result count, and the preview discloses omitted matches rather than silently presenting a partial collection as complete.

capabilities.title: Bind nested relationship fields
capabilities.outcome: A compatible target can traverse a declared bounded reference path, with missing relation steps identified precisely instead of throwing an unhandled rendering error.

capabilities.title: Declare binding empty states
capabilities.outcome: An author configures a distinct empty-result presentation for a repeated region, and preview can show it without deleting records or changing the saved query.

capabilities.title: Declare binding missing-value fallbacks
capabilities.outcome: A binding can define explicit fallback values for absent optional data, preserving the distinction between an empty value, zero, false and a missing field.

capabilities.title: Preview binding validation failures
capabilities.outcome: An author can inspect incompatible fixture values through a labeled preview state that identifies the field path and preserves the last valid binding configuration.

capabilities.title: Inspect active record context
capabilities.outcome: Selecting a bound node shows the local collection, record identifier and query context that produced it, without turning preview data into editable source text.

capabilities.title: Switch synthetic binding fixtures
capabilities.outcome: An author can choose a named synthetic dataset for a binding preview and return to the previous dataset without altering authored binding definitions.

capabilities.title: Inspect binding consumer locations
capabilities.outcome: Selecting a schema field lists its bound nodes and component inputs, with navigation to each local page and a clear indication of unsupported source targets.

capabilities.title: Detach bindings with explicit outcomes
capabilities.outcome: An author can review whether detaching a binding restores a prior literal, applies a declared fallback or leaves an empty value before confirming the change.

capabilities.title: Validate bindings after schema changes
capabilities.outcome: A schema migration reports bindings whose field paths or types no longer resolve, blocking only affected required release targets until those bindings are repaired.

capabilities.title: Preview locale-aware field resolution
capabilities.outcome: A bound node can resolve a field through the selected locale and explicit fallback chain, with the originating locale displayed in the inspector.

capabilities.title: Export binding definition manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local export describes query predicates, field paths, target identities and fallback rules without including runtime tokens or unrelated private record values.

capabilities.title: Restore binding configuration snapshots
capabilities.outcome: Restoring a local binding snapshot validates target nodes and captured schema versions together, refusing stale references instead of reassigning them by visible label.

families.name: CMS editorial workflow and review
families.scope: Manage explicit local draft, review and approval states for synthetic content without representing them as provider publication.
families.refusal: Refuse invalid state transitions, approvals against stale revisions and release inclusion that violates the declared local review policy.
families.recovery: Retain prior content revisions and review records so withdrawal or Undo restores the exact reviewed local state and pending decisions.
families.feedback: Show current content state, reviewed revision, remaining reviewers and transition consequences through readable, keyboard-accessible controls.
families.evidence: Use synthetic authors and reviewer roles to verify revision-bound decisions, stale approval refusal and exact transition histories without identity-provider claims.

capabilities.title: Create local content drafts
capabilities.outcome: An author can create a synthetic content draft that remains separate from any locally approved release version and has an explicit initial revision.

capabilities.title: Submit content for review
capabilities.outcome: A draft can be submitted with a bounded review note and exact content revision, making the reviewed snapshot distinct from later edits.

capabilities.title: Assign synthetic content reviewers
capabilities.outcome: A local workflow can declare fictional reviewer roles and required decision counts without provisioning real accounts or implying authenticated identity authority.

capabilities.title: Inspect review-ready validation
capabilities.outcome: Before submission, the editor reports required field, reference and content-policy failures that prevent the selected revision from entering the declared review state.

capabilities.title: Approve exact content revisions
capabilities.outcome: A synthetic reviewer can approve the explicitly displayed local revision, and later content changes invalidate that approval according to the declared workflow policy.

capabilities.title: Request revision changes
capabilities.outcome: A review decision can return a bounded change request tied to the reviewed revision, preserving prior approvals and decisions in their historical context.

capabilities.title: Withdraw pending review submissions
capabilities.outcome: An author can withdraw a pending submission explicitly, with the review snapshot retained and the draft state restored without deleting earlier review evidence.

capabilities.title: Compare submitted and current content
capabilities.outcome: The review screen shows a semantic difference between the submitted revision and current draft, identifying stale decisions before another transition is allowed.

capabilities.title: Resolve review decision conflicts
capabilities.outcome: When required reviewers disagree, the workflow presents the conflicting decisions and the declared resolution route rather than silently accepting the latest click.

capabilities.title: Add field-specific review comments
capabilities.outcome: A reviewer can attach a bounded comment to a stable field identity and revision, keeping it distinct from general record discussion or source-code comments.

capabilities.title: Inspect content transition history
capabilities.outcome: A record displays its ordered local state transitions with revision and synthetic actor references, without claiming that a real provider action occurred.

capabilities.title: Configure local review requirements
capabilities.outcome: A workspace author can define allowed local transitions and required review roles, with policy changes previewing their effect on currently pending submissions.

capabilities.title: Validate review policy changes
capabilities.outcome: Changing review requirements identifies submissions that need renewed decisions and preserves existing historical approvals without retroactively rewriting their original policy context.

capabilities.title: Prevent stale approval reuse
capabilities.outcome: A local release cannot consume an approval for a different content revision, and the UI identifies the exact revision mismatch before release preparation proceeds.

capabilities.title: Preview release eligibility
capabilities.outcome: An author can inspect which selected records satisfy the local review policy and which remain excluded, with reasons shown before assembling a release candidate.

capabilities.title: Record local editorial handoffs
capabilities.outcome: A content author can assign the next fictional workflow responsibility with a note, preserving revision context without sending messages or changing real membership access.

capabilities.title: Filter editorial work queues
capabilities.outcome: Authors can filter local content by review state, declared reviewer role, collection and stale-decision status without accessing external task or identity services.

capabilities.title: Bulk submit eligible drafts
capabilities.outcome: A reviewed bulk action previews eligible drafts and per-record exclusions, then submits only the exact selected revisions without partially accepting invalid records silently.

capabilities.title: Bulk withdraw pending submissions
capabilities.outcome: A confirmation lists the exact pending local submissions to withdraw and preserves their review records, leaving unrelated drafts and approved release snapshots unchanged.

capabilities.title: Export editorial decision manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local export includes content revision references, declared workflow policy and synthetic review decisions with clear mock provenance and no identity-provider tokens.

families.name: Content revisions snapshots and local releases
families.scope: Capture immutable local content versions and release sets with explicit dependency scope and restore consequences.
families.refusal: Refuse stale revisions, missing release dependencies, mutable historical captures and restores that cannot preserve required graph integrity.
families.recovery: Retain complete captured records and manifests so restore, release withdrawal and failed promotion can return to a coherent previous local state.
families.feedback: Show draft versus captured versions, included collections, excluded records and exact release or restore effects before confirmation.
families.evidence: Use divergent drafts and immutable fixture releases to verify historical fidelity, dependency validation, semantic differences and atomic local restoration.

capabilities.title: Capture immutable content revisions
capabilities.outcome: A content save can produce an immutable local revision with stable record identity and normalized content digest, while the editable draft continues independently.

capabilities.title: Compare semantic content revisions
capabilities.outcome: An author compares two captured revisions by typed field and relation changes rather than raw JSON formatting or transient editor state.

capabilities.title: Name content revision checkpoints
capabilities.outcome: An author can attach a bounded label to a captured local revision without changing its content digest, original capture time or record identity.

capabilities.title: Inspect captured relation versions
capabilities.outcome: A revision inspector shows which referenced record versions were captured with the content, separating historical references from current live draft relationships.

capabilities.title: Prepare local content releases
capabilities.outcome: An author selects reviewed content revisions into a named local release candidate that remains separate from provider or production publication.

capabilities.title: Validate local release dependency closure
capabilities.outcome: A release check identifies required related records and assets missing from the selected revision set before an immutable release artifact can be prepared.

capabilities.title: Preview release record differences
capabilities.outcome: A local comparison shows added, changed and removed records between two release candidates, including relation and media references without displaying unrelated hidden fields.

capabilities.title: Freeze local content release manifests
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed local release freeze records exact schema, record, asset and review references with digests, preventing subsequent draft changes from mutating the frozen artifact.

capabilities.title: Inspect release portability limits
capabilities.outcome: A release inspector lists unsupported field kinds, provider references and unavailable artifacts for a chosen export target before packaging is offered.

capabilities.title: Restore individual content revisions
capabilities.outcome: An author can preview and restore a captured record revision while validating its schema and required relationships against the intended current local workspace.

capabilities.title: Preview multi-collection content restores
capabilities.outcome: A restore preview lists changed records and relation consequences across selected collections, preserving the exact captured source versions and current unselected scope.

capabilities.title: Apply atomic content release restores
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed restore accepts a complete validated release scope as one local command, rejecting the operation without partial record replacement when dependencies fail.

capabilities.title: Undo content release restores
capabilities.outcome: An author can undo the most recent eligible content restore using its captured pre-change state, with current revision conflicts preventing unsafe reversal.

capabilities.title: Inspect release exclusion reasons
capabilities.outcome: The release builder identifies why each selected draft, invalid record or unsupported artifact was excluded, without converting excluded content into silently accepted output.

capabilities.title: Withdraw local release candidates
capabilities.outcome: An author can withdraw a prepared local candidate from active preview choices while retaining its immutable artifact and historical references for later inspection.

capabilities.title: Fork drafts from captured revisions
capabilities.outcome: An author can create an editable draft from a selected historical revision without modifying that revision or assigning the draft the same revision identity.

capabilities.title: Inspect content release lineage
capabilities.outcome: The release view shows predecessor candidates, source captures and restore ancestry using explicit identifiers rather than inferring history from labels or timestamps alone.

capabilities.title: Export local release bundles
capabilities.outcome: A local export contains exactly the reviewed release's schema and artifact closure, with a manifest describing omitted runtime state and provider-bound resources.

capabilities.title: Validate imported release snapshots
capabilities.outcome: A local import validates release digests, schema compatibility and required relation closure before offering the snapshot as a preview or restore candidate.

capabilities.title: Compare release restoration outcomes
capabilities.outcome: After a local restore, the builder compares accepted record and relation digests with the reviewed candidate and reports any mismatch instead of declaring success optimistically.

families.name: Content localization and fallback rules
families.scope: Author explicit local locales, translation records and fallback chains without automatic translation services or provider locale creation.
families.refusal: Refuse invalid language tags, fallback cycles, ambiguous localized identities and locale changes that silently overwrite other language values.
families.recovery: Retain source and localized revisions with prior fallback rules so failed migrations or Undo restore the original language-specific content.
families.feedback: Show selected locale, source locale, missing translations and resolved fallback provenance in content editors and canvas bindings.
families.evidence: Use synthetic multilingual, right-to-left and missing-translation fixtures to verify identity, fallback, formatting and review boundaries.

capabilities.title: Declare local content locales
capabilities.outcome: An author creates a local locale record with a valid language tag, display name and direction, without creating any locale in an external provider.

capabilities.title: Choose source content locales
capabilities.outcome: A collection can declare its source locale explicitly, and newly created localized records retain a stable relationship to the original content identity.

capabilities.title: Configure locale fallback chains
capabilities.outcome: An author defines an ordered fallback chain whose resolution is visible per field, with cycles and nonexistent locale references rejected before acceptance.

capabilities.title: Inspect missing translation coverage
capabilities.outcome: A collection view identifies untranslated required fields and records by locale, distinguishing intentionally inherited values from missing translation work.

capabilities.title: Edit localized field values
capabilities.outcome: An author can edit a locale-specific value without overwriting source-language or sibling-locale values, preserving explicit empty values when the schema allows them.

capabilities.title: Choose field localization behavior
capabilities.outcome: A schema can declare fields shared, localized or explicitly inherited, with migration previews showing how existing locale values will be preserved.

capabilities.title: Preview locale-specific content
capabilities.outcome: The canvas can render a chosen locale fixture while the inspector identifies each bound value's locale and fallback origin without altering saved content.

capabilities.title: Inspect right-to-left content direction
capabilities.outcome: A locale preview applies declared text direction and reveals unsupported component assumptions without rewriting source structure or claiming complete bidirectional-language acceptance.

capabilities.title: Manage localized slugs
capabilities.outcome: An author can define locale-specific route slugs with uniqueness validation within the declared route scope and explicit links to the same underlying content identity.

capabilities.title: Preview locale route mappings
capabilities.outcome: A local route preview lists source and localized paths plus fallback behavior, identifying collisions before any route artifact is generated.

capabilities.title: Compare source translation changes
capabilities.outcome: A translation editor shows source-field changes since the locale's last reviewed revision, preventing outdated translations from appearing freshly verified automatically.

capabilities.title: Submit localized revisions for review
capabilities.outcome: A locale-specific review submission binds the exact translated revision and source revision context, keeping its approval independent from other locales.
