capabilities.title: Preserve translated rich-text structure
capabilities.outcome: A localized rich-text editor retains declared document structure and embedded reference identities while allowing only supported language-specific content changes.

capabilities.title: Resolve localized media choices
capabilities.outcome: A local content record can select locale-specific media references with explicit fallback rules, while shared asset metadata and contextual alternatives remain distinguishable.

capabilities.title: Inspect locale-specific formatting
capabilities.outcome: A preview can show declared number and date formatting for a locale while preserving the underlying typed data and explicit timezone semantics.

capabilities.title: Bulk inspect translation states
capabilities.outcome: Authors can filter records by locale and declared translation state, with bounded summaries that avoid exposing hidden content across unrelated collections.

capabilities.title: Preview locale removal effects
capabilities.outcome: Before removing a locale from active editing, the builder lists affected records, routes and fallback chains and requires explicit preservation or remapping choices.

capabilities.title: Archive locale editing scopes
capabilities.outcome: An author can archive a locale from active authoring while retaining its captured translations and historical release references for inspection and recovery.

capabilities.title: Export localization manifests
capabilities.outcome: A local export includes locale identities, source relationships, field rules and fallback chains, with provider locale mappings labeled as external references only.

capabilities.title: Validate localization snapshot restores
capabilities.outcome: A restore check verifies locale records, translation identities and fallback dependencies together so restoring one language cannot silently orphan another language's content.

families.name: Local content search and indexing
families.scope: Build explicit bounded search indexes from approved synthetic content fields with deterministic query and result contracts.
families.refusal: Refuse secret or excluded fields, unbounded indexing, unsafe query expressions and results outside the declared local collection and locale scope.
families.recovery: Keep index input revisions and prior index manifests so failed rebuilds retain the last verified index without pretending it reflects newer content.
families.feedback: Show indexed fields, input freshness, result scope, ranking explanations and truncation notices using accessible result controls.
families.evidence: Use controlled text and reference fixtures to verify exact inclusion, exclusion, ranking, locale behavior and stale-index reporting.

capabilities.title: Declare searchable content fields
capabilities.outcome: A collection author selects fields eligible for local indexing, with excluded or private fields remaining outside search even when they exist in a record.

capabilities.title: Build deterministic local search indexes
capabilities.outcome: A local index command records its schema and content input revisions and produces reproducible normalized index artifacts from the same approved synthetic dataset.

capabilities.title: Inspect search index freshness
capabilities.outcome: The search inspector compares indexed input revisions with current local content and labels stale indexes without claiming that a successful prior build is current.

capabilities.title: Query local indexed content
capabilities.outcome: A search preview accepts bounded text queries against a selected index and returns stable record references without contacting provider or external search services.

capabilities.title: Filter search results by collection
capabilities.outcome: Authors can scope a query to declared collections, with result counts and omitted-scope indicators that do not leak excluded collection content.

capabilities.title: Filter search results by locale
capabilities.outcome: A query can target a declared locale and explicit fallback policy, with every result identifying whether its matched content came from a fallback language.

capabilities.title: Configure search result sorting
capabilities.outcome: An author chooses supported ranking or deterministic sort rules with stable tie-breakers, and preview shows why each result occupies its reported position.

capabilities.title: Inspect matched field explanations
capabilities.outcome: A result inspector identifies the approved fields and terms responsible for a match using bounded excerpts, without revealing excluded or hidden field values.

capabilities.title: Configure exact-match search behavior
capabilities.outcome: A search contract can declare exact phrase or token matching rules, and synthetic query examples show the difference without changing the indexed source records.

capabilities.title: Configure prefix search behavior
capabilities.outcome: An author can enable bounded prefix matching for eligible fields, with minimum-query constraints and explicit result limits preventing uncontrolled scans.

capabilities.title: Configure content search facets
capabilities.outcome: A local index can expose declared enum or taxonomy fields as facets, preserving schema-defined labels and counts within the active query scope.

capabilities.title: Preview empty search results
capabilities.outcome: Authors can render a declared no-results state for a synthetic query while keeping it distinct from unavailable, stale or failed index states.

capabilities.title: Preview unavailable search indexes
capabilities.outcome: A controlled preview displays an actionable unavailable-index state without substituting unindexed full-record scanning or claiming a missing index returned no matches.

capabilities.title: Bound search result pagination
capabilities.outcome: A local query returns stable bounded pages with explicit continuation and total-count qualification, avoiding duplicate or skipped results across a fixed index revision.

capabilities.title: Inspect search query budgets
capabilities.outcome: The search inspector reports query length, token and result limits, and refuses oversized requests before evaluating them against local content indexes.

capabilities.title: Rebuild selected content indexes
capabilities.outcome: An author can rebuild a chosen index scope without replacing unrelated indexes, and failure preserves the previously verified artifact and its original freshness label.

capabilities.title: Validate search result link targets
capabilities.outcome: A result binding checks declared local route references and reports broken destinations before a search preview or local release includes unusable result links.

capabilities.title: Export local search artifacts
capabilities.outcome: A local export packages a selected verified index with input revision and field-inclusion manifests, excluding private drafts and runtime credentials by declared policy.

capabilities.title: Import compatible search indexes
capabilities.outcome: An imported index is validated against its schema, locale and content identity contracts before it can be selected for local preview queries.

capabilities.title: Compare search index revisions
capabilities.outcome: Authors can inspect changes in indexed fields, input revisions and controlled query results between two local index artifacts without treating those examples as exhaustive relevance evaluation.

families.name: Reusable page and collection templates
families.scope: Create versioned document-owned page templates and instantiate them with explicit ownership, route and migration contracts.
families.refusal: Refuse incompatible template imports, route collisions, unsupported source round trips and upgrades that silently overwrite instance-owned content.
families.recovery: Retain template definitions and instance override mappings so rejected upgrades or Undo restore the exact prior page configuration.
families.feedback: Show template versus page ownership, version pins, route placeholders, instance overrides and proposed shared-update effects before confirmation.
families.evidence: Use multiple pages from one template with distinct content and route values to verify isolation, guarded upgrades and coherent recovery.

capabilities.title: Create reusable page templates
capabilities.outcome: An author captures an eligible document-owned page structure as a named versioned template, with explicit ownership and reusable input contracts recorded separately from page instances.

capabilities.title: Instantiate pages from templates
capabilities.outcome: A template can create a new local page with distinct node identities, declared inputs and an explicitly reviewed route, preserving the original template definition.

capabilities.title: Declare template route parameters
capabilities.outcome: An author defines typed route placeholders for a page template, and instance creation validates required parameters and resulting local route uniqueness before acceptance.

capabilities.title: Inspect template instance ownership
capabilities.outcome: Selecting a templated page shows which regions follow the template and which are instance-owned overrides, with unsupported source mappings remaining visibly read-only.

capabilities.title: Choose template version pins
capabilities.outcome: A page instance can pin a specific template version so a newer definition does not silently alter its structure or declared content inputs.

capabilities.title: Preview shared template updates
capabilities.outcome: A proposed template change lists affected page instances and displays shared versus overridden differences without modifying the instance pages during preview.

capabilities.title: Preserve template content overrides
capabilities.outcome: A compatible template upgrade retains declared instance content and slot overrides by stable identities, requiring explicit mapping for any removed or changed target.

capabilities.title: Detach pages from templates
capabilities.outcome: An author can review and detach one page into independent document ownership while preserving its rendered content and identifying which future template updates will stop applying.

capabilities.title: Create collection detail templates
capabilities.outcome: A document-owned template can declare a typed single-record context for generating local collection detail previews without publishing provider routes or content.

capabilities.title: Create collection listing templates
capabilities.outcome: An author can define a reusable listing page template with explicit query inputs and empty-state contracts, preserving page-specific filters as declared instance values.

capabilities.title: Inspect template dependency closure
capabilities.outcome: A template inspector lists required component releases, assets and collection schemas, identifying unavailable dependencies before local page instantiation can proceed.

capabilities.title: Preview template route collisions
capabilities.outcome: Creating or upgrading template instances shows resulting local paths and existing conflicts, requiring an explicit route change before any page records are accepted.

capabilities.title: Compare template revisions
capabilities.outcome: Authors can compare two template versions by node identities, inputs, routes and dependency changes, with formatting-only source differences distinguished from semantic template changes.

capabilities.title: Migrate template input keys
capabilities.outcome: A template upgrade can map renamed input keys into existing page instances, rejecting ambiguous or incompatible values without overwriting their prior configurations.

capabilities.title: Archive unused page templates
capabilities.outcome: An author can archive a template with no active dependent pages from default creation choices while retaining its captured versions and recoverable metadata.

capabilities.title: Restore archived page templates
capabilities.outcome: An archived local template can return under its original identity when its referenced artifacts and dependency contracts still validate against the local registry.

capabilities.title: Import page template previews
capabilities.outcome: A local import previews template identities, dependencies, ownership conflicts and unsupported features before any definitions are added to the active creation library.

capabilities.title: Namespace imported page templates
capabilities.outcome: An author can assign a stable namespace to imported templates while retaining original provenance and avoiding identity collisions with existing local template definitions.

capabilities.title: Export portable template bundles
capabilities.outcome: A local export packages selected template definitions with required component and asset manifests, identifying provider-bound references that the chosen target cannot reproduce.

capabilities.title: Validate template restoration snapshots
capabilities.outcome: A template snapshot restore validates definitions, pinned versions and instance mappings together, refusing a partial restore that would leave pages attached to missing templates.

families.name: Content import export and migration mapping
families.scope: Preview and validate local content transfer formats with explicit identity, schema, relation and destructive-change mappings.
families.refusal: Refuse oversized or malformed input, path traversal, secret-shaped fields, unresolved required mappings and imports that silently overwrite existing content.
families.recovery: Capture the pre-import graph and accepted mapping so failures roll back atomically and an eligible Undo restores the exact prior local workspace.
families.feedback: Provide row and field error locations, target identity previews, conflict counts and explicit create/update/delete effects before confirmation.
families.evidence: Use synthetic CSV and JSON files with duplicates, schema drift, malformed rows and related records to verify deterministic previews and lossless refusal.

capabilities.title: Preview CSV collection imports
capabilities.outcome: An author can inspect a bounded local CSV file, declared encoding and column samples before selecting a target collection or authorizing any record changes.

capabilities.title: Map CSV columns to fields
capabilities.outcome: An import editor maps columns into compatible schema fields, identifying required fields and unsupported conversions before generating a proposed local record set.

capabilities.title: Preview JSON collection imports
capabilities.outcome: A local JSON import validates a declared supported envelope and shows collection, record and schema identities without executing embedded content or applying changes automatically.

capabilities.title: Map external record identities
capabilities.outcome: An author can map explicit imported identifiers to local record identities, with duplicate or ambiguous matches requiring a reviewed resolution before import acceptance.

capabilities.title: Choose import create update policies
capabilities.outcome: An import preview separates proposed creations and updates according to declared identity rules, without inferring deletion of unmentioned records from absence in the input file.

capabilities.title: Detect duplicate import rows
capabilities.outcome: The importer reports conflicting rows that resolve to the same local identity or unique key, preserving all row locations until an explicit policy resolves them.

capabilities.title: Validate import field conversions
capabilities.outcome: Each proposed conversion reports input location, target type and acceptance result, refusing silent truncation or lossy coercion of values outside the declared schema.

capabilities.title: Resolve imported relation targets
capabilities.outcome: An import preview maps relationship identifiers against the proposed and existing local graph, requiring every required target to resolve before any records are committed.

capabilities.title: Preview imported media mappings
capabilities.outcome: An author can map imported media references to eligible local assets, with remote or missing references retained as unresolved requirements rather than downloaded automatically.

capabilities.title: Inspect import scope effects
capabilities.outcome: A confirmation view lists exact collections, records, fields and relation edges affected by the reviewed import, with unrelated workspace scope explicitly preserved.

capabilities.title: Apply atomic local content imports
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed import validates the same input digest and mapping revision, then accepts the reviewed graph atomically or leaves the existing local workspace unchanged.

capabilities.title: Undo accepted content imports
capabilities.outcome: An eligible import can be undone using its captured pre-import graph, with stale target revisions refusing reversal instead of overwriting subsequent local edits.

capabilities.title: Export selected collection records
capabilities.outcome: An author can export explicitly selected local records in a supported JSON envelope, with schema versions and required reference scope disclosed before creating the file.

capabilities.title: Export collection CSV projections
capabilities.outcome: A CSV export uses an explicit supported field projection and declares how nested values, references and empty values are represented without promising a lossless arbitrary graph round trip.

capabilities.title: Export complete content transfer bundles
capabilities.outcome: A local transfer bundle captures declared schemas, record identities, relationships and required assets with digests, excluding runtime credentials and unrelated workspace data.

capabilities.title: Compare migration mapping revisions
capabilities.outcome: Authors can compare two import mapping configurations by target fields, conversion rules and identity policies before reusing a previously prepared migration recipe.

capabilities.title: Save reusable import mappings
capabilities.outcome: An author can save a local mapping recipe keyed to supported source and target schemas, with later schema drift requiring renewed validation before the recipe is applied.

capabilities.title: Preview schema upgrade imports
capabilities.outcome: An import targeting a newer collection schema shows required migrations and incompatible records before accepting data into the active local collection version.

capabilities.title: Inspect partial export limitations
capabilities.outcome: Before export, the builder identifies omitted referenced records or unsupported fields and requires a declared boundary rather than presenting an incomplete bundle as fully portable.

capabilities.title: Verify transferred content digests
capabilities.outcome: After importing a compatible local transfer bundle, the builder compares accepted normalized record and relation digests with the reviewed manifest and reports any mismatch explicitly.

families.name: Content validation and publication readiness
families.scope: Inspect cross-field content quality and declared local release requirements without claiming automatic editorial, accessibility or legal approval.
families.refusal: Refuse release eligibility when required declared checks fail, and never treat missing measurements or reviewer decisions as passing evidence.
families.recovery: Preserve prior valid content and check results with their examined revisions so corrections or reruns do not rewrite historical findings.
families.feedback: Present actionable field and node locations, requirement severity and evidence scope with text descriptions and keyboard navigation.
families.evidence: Use synthetic content with broken links, missing alternatives, schema conflicts and stale reviews to verify exact findings and unchanged excluded scope.

capabilities.title: Validate required content fields
capabilities.outcome: A local content check reports required fields that are absent or invalid at exact record paths, preserving intentional empty values when the schema explicitly permits them.

capabilities.title: Validate local content link references
capabilities.outcome: A check resolves declared local content routes and asset references, identifying broken targets without sending requests to arbitrary external destinations or changing saved link values.

capabilities.title: Inspect content heading structure
capabilities.outcome: A preview audit reports declared heading-level and landmark problems within the selected content scope, linking findings to canonical node identities for review.

capabilities.title: Inspect contextual image alternatives
capabilities.outcome: A content report identifies informative image uses missing required contextual alternatives and distinguishes deliberately decorative instances from untranslated or absent descriptions.

capabilities.title: Validate rich-text allowed structures
capabilities.outcome: A check identifies unsupported blocks, marks or embeds in rich-text fields using the active schema contract, without silently removing content during validation.

capabilities.title: Inspect duplicate content slugs
capabilities.outcome: A local report lists records whose normalized slugs collide within the declared collection, route and locale scope, with stable identifiers for explicit repair.

capabilities.title: Validate content date relationships
capabilities.outcome: A schema can declare supported cross-field date ordering rules, and records violating those relationships receive precise field-level findings before release eligibility is accepted.

capabilities.title: Validate numeric content relationships
capabilities.outcome: A collection can declare bounded numeric comparisons across supported fields, with invalid or missing operands shown separately from a rule that evaluated false.

capabilities.title: Inspect content length budgets
capabilities.outcome: A local check measures declared plain-text and rich-text limits using documented counting rules, identifying overflow locations without trimming saved values automatically.

capabilities.title: Inspect content language declarations
capabilities.outcome: A report identifies content missing required language declarations or translations, keeping author declarations distinct from any unverified automated language inference.

capabilities.title: Inspect broken relation summaries
capabilities.outcome: A readiness check identifies references whose required target or approved summary field is unavailable, without exposing hidden values from inaccessible target records.

capabilities.title: Validate required editorial approval
capabilities.outcome: A release eligibility check verifies approval against the exact selected content revision and active local review policy, refusing stale or incomplete decisions.

capabilities.title: Inspect media transcript requirements
capabilities.outcome: A content report identifies declared media uses missing required captions or transcript references, while avoiding a claim that file presence proves their human-reviewed quality.

capabilities.title: Validate declared citation references
capabilities.outcome: A local check verifies required citation records and source-reference fields are present and structurally valid, without asserting that referenced claims are scientifically or legally correct.

capabilities.title: Inspect content ownership declarations
capabilities.outcome: A readiness report identifies records or assets missing required provenance or ownership declarations and distinguishes unresolved declarations from verified content permissions.

capabilities.title: Preview content error severity
capabilities.outcome: An author can configure supported advisory and blocking severities for declared local checks, with release consequences shown before the policy revision is accepted.

capabilities.title: Navigate content validation findings
capabilities.outcome: Authors can move through a bounded findings list by keyboard and open the exact record, field or node associated with each reported local failure.

capabilities.title: Compare content readiness runs
capabilities.outcome: A comparison shows newly introduced, resolved and unchanged findings between examined content revisions, preserving the original timestamps and scope of prior check runs.

capabilities.title: Export content readiness reports
capabilities.outcome: An author can export a bounded local report containing examined revisions, rule identities and findings, excluding unrelated private field values and runtime credentials.

capabilities.title: Verify release readiness scope
capabilities.outcome: Before a local release is frozen, the builder confirms required checks examined its exact schema and content revisions, identifying any unexamined or stale input scope explicitly.

families.name: Synthetic content fixtures and deterministic previews
families.scope: Create reproducible fictional content datasets and named preview scenarios without importing real personal records or altering provider state.
families.refusal: Refuse secret-bearing fixture input, uncontrolled graph size, incoherent required references and any operation that treats synthetic actors as authenticated identities.
families.recovery: Keep fixture recipes, seeds and named dataset snapshots so a failed generation or reset can restore the exact selected synthetic preview context.
families.feedback: Label synthetic datasets, seeds, coverage gaps and reset effects prominently, with explicit separation from emulator, provider and production data.
families.evidence: Use fixed seeds and declared schemas to reproduce valid and intentionally invalid fixture scenarios, verifying exact graph identities and bounded generation.

capabilities.title: Define seeded content fixture recipes
capabilities.outcome: An author can create a local fixture recipe with a declared deterministic seed and schema version, producing repeatable fictional content without provider access.

capabilities.title: Generate schema-valid fictional records
capabilities.outcome: A fixture generator creates bounded synthetic records satisfying the selected schema's required types and constraints, with generated identities and provenance labeled explicitly.

capabilities.title: Generate coherent relation fixtures
capabilities.outcome: A fixture recipe can produce related collections whose required edges resolve within the generated dataset, preserving deterministic identities across identical generation inputs.

capabilities.title: Create empty content scenarios
capabilities.outcome: Authors can select a named empty-collection fixture to preview declared empty states without deleting saved content from the active local authoring workspace.

capabilities.title: Create missing-field preview scenarios
capabilities.outcome: A controlled fixture can omit specific declared fields for previewing error or fallback behavior, with its intentional invalidity shown independently from normal authored records.

capabilities.title: Create broken-reference preview scenarios
capabilities.outcome: A synthetic scenario can contain explicitly declared unresolved references for testing local diagnostics, without modifying coherent datasets or pretending the scenario is release-ready.

capabilities.title: Create multilingual content fixtures
capabilities.outcome: A recipe can generate declared locale records and intentional translation gaps, preserving consistent source identities and explicit fallback expectations for repeatable preview comparisons.

capabilities.title: Create long-content preview scenarios
capabilities.outcome: Authors can generate bounded long labels and rich-text examples that exercise wrapping and overflow behavior without inserting real user content or exceeding fixture resource budgets.

capabilities.title: Create Unicode content fixtures
capabilities.outcome: A synthetic dataset can include declared script, emoji and combining-character examples so content rendering and limits can be inspected with reproducible inputs.

capabilities.title: Create media-failure fixture scenarios
capabilities.outcome: A preview fixture can reference intentionally unavailable synthetic media targets, labeling those failures without removing actual assets or changing the selected component's authored references.

capabilities.title: Select named content preview datasets
capabilities.outcome: An author can switch a preview between named synthetic datasets while preserving authored schemas, component definitions and query bindings outside the selected preview context.

capabilities.title: Inspect fixture generation provenance
capabilities.outcome: The fixture inspector shows recipe identity, seed, schema revisions and generation bounds so a result can be reproduced without relying on a transient process identifier.

capabilities.title: Preview fixture reset effects
capabilities.outcome: Before resetting a selected synthetic dataset, the builder lists affected collections, records and preview selections while identifying unrelated authored content that remains outside reset scope.

capabilities.title: Reset selected fixture datasets
capabilities.outcome: A confirmed reset regenerates only the reviewed dataset from its retained recipe and seed, with coherent relationships restored and unrelated local datasets preserved.

capabilities.title: Fork fixture datasets for experiments
capabilities.outcome: An author can create an independent synthetic dataset from a captured fixture snapshot, preserving origin provenance while assigning distinct workspace identities for subsequent experimentation.

capabilities.title: Compare fixture dataset revisions
capabilities.outcome: A comparison reports record, relationship and locale changes between two captured synthetic datasets without treating regenerated timestamps or presentation labels as stable identity.

capabilities.title: Bind deterministic preview clocks
capabilities.outcome: A content preview can use an explicitly selected fictional clock for date-dependent scenarios, with actual system time and provider schedules left unchanged.

capabilities.title: Inspect fixture coverage matrices
capabilities.outcome: A local report lists which declared component, locale, empty-state and validation scenarios have fixture datasets, distinguishing missing coverage from completed runtime verification.

capabilities.title: Export synthetic fixture packs
capabilities.outcome: An author can export named fictional datasets together with recipes, seeds and schema contracts, with clear synthetic provenance and no credentials or host-specific runtime paths.

capabilities.title: Validate imported fixture packs
capabilities.outcome: A local fixture import checks schema compatibility, bounded graph shape, synthetic provenance and required references before exposing the dataset as an eligible preview choice.
